description.en: Makes a match member forget a previously learned technique/skill, looked up by team slot and character ID.
Index of the team/side the character belongs to.
Character ID string identifying which member forgets the skill.
Optional flag; when explicitly false, also frees up the member's internal skill slot so a new one can be learned in its place.
Always null — the native implementation never pushes a value onto the stack on success; null is also returned if fewer than 3 arguments were given.

example.code:
// Make a match member forget a technique and free up its skill slot
CMND_BTL_FORGET_SKILL(1, "para_cp0010", "whs0035", false);
